finance.title: AI funding fears rattle Wall Street. Here's how we're adjusting our portfolio
finance.summary: The rotation out of AI stocks benefited several defensive Club stocks.
finance.title_cn: 人工智能领域的融资问题让华尔街感到担忧。我们正在调整我们的投资组合以应对这种情况。
finance.summary_cn: 人工智能相关股票的下跌，使得一些防御性强的俱乐部股票受益了。

finance.title: Retail investors are not more sophisticated than 30 years ago, says former hedge fund manager
finance.summary: Retail investors trying to beat the market by buying individual stocks and complex exchange-traded funds may be better off with broad market index funds.
finance.title_cn: 前对冲基金经理表示，散户投资者并没有比30年前更成熟了。
finance.summary_cn: 那些试图通过购买单个股票或复杂的交易所交易基金来战胜市场的散户投资者，或许更适合选择宽基指数基金作为投资工具。

finance.title: I quit my marketing job to walk dogs for 4 months: It's 'one of the most valuable professional experiences I've ever had'
finance.summary: "People sometimes assume dog walking was a gap or detour in my career. I see it as one of the most valuable professional experiences I've had," says Sally Simmons.
finance.title_cn: 我辞去了市场营销工作，转而从事了四个月的遛狗工作。这真是“我有生以来最宝贵的职业经历之一”。
finance.summary_cn: “有些人认为，带狗散步这种行为，其实是对我职业生涯的一种干扰或浪费时间。不过，我认为这是我所经历过的最有价值的职业经历之一，”萨莉·西蒙斯说道。

finance.title: An ex-bookkeeper spent $375 to launch a sewing business: 'I hadn't felt so sure about something like that in a long time'
finance.summary: Eric Lugo runs Stitch Lab ATX, a sewing studio that offers group classes and events to teach basic sewing skills.
finance.title_cn: 一位前会计花费了375美元来创办了一家缝纫店：“我已经很久没有对这样的事情如此充满信心了。”
finance.summary_cn: 埃里克·卢戈经营着Stitch Lab ATX这家缝纫工作室，该工作室提供团体课程和活动，旨在教授基本的缝纫技能。

finance.title: Fact vs. fiction: Doctors share whether peptides are safe and effective
finance.summary: As peptides gain popularity among some wellness influencers and federal government officials, doctors share what you need to know.
finance.title_cn: 事实与虚构：专家们正在讨论肽类物质是否安全且有效
finance.summary_cn: 随着肽类物质在一些健康领域的知名人士和联邦政府官员中越来越受到关注，医生们也分享了一些相关知识。

ai.title: AI could unlock USD 2.52 trillion in annual global economic value, rising costs pose risk: McKinsey
ai.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) could generate USD 2.52 trillion in annual economic value globally by automating and supporting existing work, but rising deployment costs could significantly reduce these potential gains, according to an October 2026 research report by McKinsey.
ai.title_cn: 人工智能能够释放每年2.52万亿美元的全球经济价值，不过不断上升的成本也带来了风险：麦肯锡公司的观点。
ai.description_cn: 根据麦肯锡在2026年10月发布的一份研究报告，通过自动化和辅助现有工作，人工智能有望在全球范围内创造2.52万亿美元的年度经济价值。不过，随着部署成本的上升，这些潜在收益可能会大大减少。

ai.title: Anwar says 'global investor' has chosen Malaysia for US$50bil tech sector investment
ai.description: MELAKA: Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim has disclosed that a global investor plans to invest US$50bil (RM204.3bil) in the artificial intelligence (AI), new technology and data centre sectors in Sarawak and Peninsular Malaysia.
ai.title_cn: 安瓦尔表示，这位“全球投资者”已经选择了马来西亚，计划在该国投资500亿美元用于科技领域的投资。
ai.description_cn: 美拉吉：总理拿督斯里安瓦鲁·伊布哈姆透露，一位全球投资者计划向沙捞越和马来半岛的人工智能、新技术以及数据中心领域投资500亿美元。

ai.title: NCERT Introduces 20-Hour AI Module For Classes 9 To 12; Deepfakes, Data Privacy And Ethical Use In Focus
ai.description: NCERT has introduced a 20-hour artificial intelligence and computational thinking module for Classes 9 to 12. Developed with IIT Madras and IIT Jodhpur, it covers machine learning, deepfake detection, misinformation, data privacy and responsible AI use. The activity-based programme offers flexible learning options, including exercises that can be conducted without computers or internet access.
ai.title_cn: NCERT为9至12年级的学生推出了一个为期20小时的AI学习模块；该模块重点探讨了深度伪造技术、数据隐私以及AI的合理使用问题。
ai.description_cn: NCERT为9至12年级的学生们推出了一门为期20小时的人工智能与计算思维课程。该课程由印度理工学院马德拉斯分校和印度理工学院焦特布尔分校联合开发，内容涵盖机器学习、深度伪造检测、错误信息识别、数据隐私保护以及负责任的人工智能应用等方面。这门以活动为基础的课程提供了灵活的学习方式，学生可以在没有计算机或互联网连接的情况下进行练习。

ai.title: AI, continuous drying, byproduct utilisation to drive rice milling profitability: Industry experts
ai.description: Adoption of artificial intelligence (AI), continuous drying systems and improved utilisation of byproducts is expected to emerge as key drivers of profitability in India's rice milling industry, with experts at the Bharat International Rice Conference 2026 highlighting the need to modernise processing practices and reduce grain breakage and buyer rejections.
ai.title_cn: 人工智能、持续干燥技术以及副产品的高效利用，这些手段共同提升了稻米加工行业的盈利能力：行业专家们的见解
ai.description_cn: 在印度水稻加工行业中，人工智能的应用、连续干燥系统的使用以及副产品利用方式的改进，有望成为提升盈利能力的关键因素。在2026年举行的Bharat国际水稻会议上，专家们强调必须现代化加工工艺，减少粮食破损现象，降低买家拒收率。

ai.title: KTR urges youth to embrace AI; calls for investor-friendly ecosystem to make Hyderabad global hub
ai.description: BRS Working President K T Rama Rao inaugurated RandomTrees’ India headquarters in Hyderabad and urged youngsters to view artificial intelligence as an opportunity for innovation and employment rather than a threat to jobs. He also called for an investor-friendly ecosystem to position Hyderabad as a global AI hub.
ai.title_cn: KTR呼吁年轻人拥抱人工智能技术；并倡导打造有利于投资者的生态系统，使海得拉巴成为全球性的科技中心。
ai.description_cn: BRS的现任主席K T Rama Rao在海得拉巴揭幕了RandomTrees的印度总部，并鼓励年轻人将人工智能视为创新和就业的机会，而不是对工作的威胁。他还呼吁打造一个有利于投资者的生态系统，以将海得拉巴建设成为全球性的AI中心。
